representative_scale.gpu_class: One H100, A100 or A10 class NVIDIA GPU; use same device for baseline and candidate. Exact available model unknown.
representative_scale.scale_policy: One fixed scale, no search, doubling loops or toy extrapolation.
representative_scale.baseline_schedule: Eight replicas sequentially in one process.
representative_scale.candidate_schedule: Eight independent replicas concurrently on the same GPU under MPS, preserving each seed and scientific configuration.

inputs.driver_source: baseline.json driver.code, copied verbatim from intake/brief.md

json_fields.replicas: Eight objects, each with replica, seed, steps, wall_s, final_potential_kj_mol, mean_potential_kj_mol.

outputs.energy_sampling: 100 potential energies per replica, at steps 250, 500, ..., 25000; mean and final written, samples not written.
outputs.scientific_comparison_interface: Compare eight per-seed final and mean energies across sequential and concurrent results; full series requires extra recording. No published numeric acceptance tolerance.
outputs.candidate_output_aggregation: Must retain per-replica fields and enclosing ensemble wall time; candidate launcher/aggregator not supplied in published brief.

timing_scope.ensemble: time.perf_counter starts after PDB loading, force-field/System construction and platform selection, immediately before replica loop; stops after last context and integrator deletion. Includes context creation, kernel compilation/initialization, velocity generation, integration, synchronized energy queries, summary construction and teardown. Excludes Python startup/imports, input parsing, force-field/System construction, output JSON writing and final printing.
timing_scope.replica: Starts after positions and velocities assigned; ends after integration and energy queries, before recording summary and context teardown.
timing_scope.candidate: One enclosing elapsed interval covering completion of all eight replicas and their context creation/initialization and teardown. Document additional process/MPS startup separately; do not sum individual replica times.

scoring_interface.correctness: Fixed seeds, work, model, device count and scientific outputs; no independent published tolerance available.

runtime_evidence.claim: About one minute on H100; a few minutes on slower GPUs.
runtime_evidence.status: Author estimate, CUDA unverified; compilation and setup time unmeasured.
runtime_evidence.budget_assessment: Expected representative workload below default run budget according to brief estimate; no measured guarantee. No workload executed at intake.

unavailable.reason: Brief supplies hypothesis and public fixed-time MPS study, but no fixed-work concurrent launcher; do not invent a published command.
